subjects: The stages that connect model evidence, live marketplace quotes, owner limits, bounded work, and cleanup
composition: One flow with a clear left-to-right reading order
Use functional labels with generous spacing
Mark target behavior as planned when implementation evidence is incomplete
text_policy: Use short, exact, functional labels in diagrams. Do not add invented metrics, provider UI, or claims of completed readiness.

system.crop_behavior: Preserve the full five-stage flow; do not crop cards or arrows.

evidence.crop_behavior: Keep source labels and uncertainty boundaries visible.

reject_when: The asset implies a paid run or verified cleanup that has not happened.
The diagram hides missing inputs, unknown terms, or incomplete retrieval.
The asset invents a price, capability, metric, or provider interface.
Labels cannot be read at the intended display size.
